about: One request end to end with real keys: open an empty folder as the project (the page's URL carries ?cwd=<the folder>: typing a path in the bottom bar went with the bar, 2026-11-13), start one agent from its + plinth with a prompt that makes Codex ask, wait for the column's ask flag (ask:<column>), open its chat window, answer in its chat (typed in the chat window's box: y, n or an option number; the card's own buttons are the other way, tested on the made-up floor by answer-on-card.json), wait for the outcome on the column (tick:<column>:<i> for approvals), watch the agent continue. Costs one Codex turn. Run with --var folder=/absolute/empty/folder (with a README.md) --var prompt='...' --var answer=y|n|<option number> --var after='tick:*' (approvals) or 'column:*' (a question leaves no tick). Prompts used 2026-11-05: a command ('Run `curl -sI https://example.com` and tell me the status line', answer y); a file change outside every writable root ('Use your file editing tool (apply_patch), not a shell command, to create the file <home>/appr-test-note.txt containing the word hi. If it is refused, stop and say so.', answer n; /tmp is writable under workspace-write, so a /tmp path does not ask); a question ('Before doing anything, ask me which of two names I prefer, A or B, using your question tool, then stop.', answer 2), which needs the server's app-server started with -c features.default_mode_request_user_input=true (Codex offers the question tool only in Plan mode otherwise).
